prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco—the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, paid media, creative/brand, B2B lead gen, e‑commerce, etc.), your budget, and the type of relationship you want (project vs. long‑term retainer).

If you tell me your goals and budget I can shortlist agencies that fit. To help now, here’s a quick plan and some names that frequently serve SF companies:

Questions I need to recommend a specific agency
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, sales, installs, content/SEO, etc.)
- Industry (SaaS, e‑commerce, consumer, B2B, fintech, health, etc.)
- Monthly budget (ad spend + agency fees) and timeline
- Do you want a full‑service agency or a specialist (SEO, paid ads, creative)?
- Preference for local/office collaboration or remote work?

How to pick the right agency (quick checklist)
- Relevant experience in your industry and channel
- Measurable case studies and KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROI)
- Clear measurement/reporting and access to raw data
- Team structure (will you get a dedicated PM, analysts, creatives?)
- Pricing and contract flexibility
- Client references and recent work
- Cultural fit and communication style

Agencies that commonly work with San Francisco tech and startups
- 3Q Digital — performance marketing, paid search/social, analytics
- Wpromote — paid media, growth marketing, creative
- Jellyfish — digital marketing, paid search, analytics and programmatic
- R/GA — creative, product and brand experience (larger enterprise/brand work)
- Razorfish — digital transformation and customer experience
- Directive — B2B SaaS performance marketing and SEO (good for lead gen)

Next step
Tell me your goals, industry, and budget and I’ll shortlist 3–5 agencies in San Francisco that are a strong fit, plus suggested questions to ask during calls.
